summary: The PR addresses the issue by modifying the logic to correctly handle fields that are not directly accessible via `hasattr` but are valid model fields. The changes appear to be well-reasoned and do not introduce obvious issues.

issues.description: While the patch fixes the specific issue, it removes the check for `hasattr(obj.model, item)`, which might have been intended to catch certain edge cases. This could potentially introduce behavioral regression if there are other scenarios where `hasattr` provides useful information.
The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the reasoning behind the changes, especially around the removal of the `hasattr` check.
